title: Mantell's plane disintegrated by magnetism

tellings.quote: Didn't say it had been blown out of the air and then crashed and it said it disintegrated.

plain: In 1948, near Fort Knox in Kentucky, the plane of a pilot named Thomas Mantell was destroyed, and the story holds that it was taken apart by magnetism. A man named Silas Newton says on the show that the account of Mantell's death "didn't say it had been blown out of the air and then crashed," it "said it disintegrated," which he takes as a sign that some unusual force, not a crash, broke the plane up.
